title: TWITTER T3 TT Carbon Triathlon Frame Set
notes: Current exact-model manufacturer frameset route. It identifies the T3 TT frame and publishes about 1.35 kg frame weight, 0.47 kg fork weight, T47 threaded BB, 700×30C maximum tire clearance and six frame sizes. The frame weight is a manufacturer claim for the frameset component and does not state finish, hardware or weighing method.

classification_history.reason: Operator identifies itself as a regional U.S. distributor; authorization is self-described, not independently verified.

authority_note: Regional US distributor source. Its statement of authorization is self-described; this source is not the manufacturer or evidence of mainland-China price or warranty.
